text:
sasha: quick heads-up — Vellum (their vendor) wants a POC to swap to our API but they asked for near drop-in compatibility. main asks: endpoint parity, prompt templating, response shape, and pricing parity. can we align?
vikram: thanks. i looked at their spec — they use /v1/predict with fields: prompt, max_len, stop_tokens, n_best. main gaps i see:
- stop handling (Vellum uses fixed token-based stops)
- n_best vs our streaming/partial n-best semantics
- tokenizer mismatch (their tokenizer yields ~2-3% token delta)
- auth header is the same so header passthrough should be trivial
morgan: for the POC i propose an adapter shim that translates requests server-side:
- map /v1/predict -> /v1/generate
- translate prompt -> input, max_len -> max_tokens, n_best -> best_of/n_candidates
- normalize stop tokens with a small preprocessor and post-filter responses for parity
- run an automated eval harness (50 deterministic prompts + 200 open prompts)
we can ship a tiny docker adapter the customer runs in front of our endpoint for the POC.
olivia: security checklist: they asked for SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, private networking (VPC peering or private endpoint), and key rotation support. also need audit logs for all admin actions.
- confirm: do we support VPC peering for Private deployments?
alex: yes for Private and Dedicated we can do VPC peering and PrivateLink. for Hosted we can provide customer-managed VPC via Private Connect in their cloud.
vikram: perf note: Vellum is currently at ~120 qps peak on their workload with p50 ~= 45ms and p95 ~= 230ms. to match we should propose Dedicated capacity with burst policy or tune batching. also quantization differences might affect latency and token output slightly.
sasha: pricing question from buyer: they pay per-request + per-token today; they want to understand delta switching to per-token only. can sales provide an equivalence comparison and migration credit?
alex: salesbot — link to the migration pricing calculator pls.
salesbot: https://redwood.internal/sales/migration-calculator — use the "vellum" profile. default migration credit: 10% off invoice for 3 months (TBD by AE).
morgan: POC plan (high level):
1) week 0: adapter + minimal mapping demo (auth + single request parity) — owner: morgan
2) week 1: eval harness run (response parity metrics, stop behavior, n_best diffs) — owner: vikram
3) week 2: perf/cost benchmarking (p50/p95, tokens per response, cost projection) — owner: alex
4) week 3: security review + contract redlines (SOC2, IP clauses) — owner: olivia
we should run a small A/B sample: 5000 requests against both systems and compute recall/precision on target outputs.
vikram: quick mapping example for the shim: `Vellum: POST /v1/predict {prompt, max_len, temp}` -> `Redwood: POST /v1/generate {input, max_tokens, temperature}`. also set `stop_strategy: 'post-filter'` for exact stop token parity.
olivia: security Q: they want an SLA on data retention and deletion. we need to confirm retention windows and describe deletion API. also they asked for encryption-at-rest details and KMS key lifecycle.
sasha: action items:
- morgan: build adapter PoC image and sample mapping doc (due Tue EOD)
- vikram: craft eval suite and run initial parity tests (due Thu)
- olivia: start the security questionnaire draft and list required artifacts (due Thu)
- alex: prepare pricing equivalence slide and draft migration credit (due Wed)
- sasha: coordinate demo with customer next Tue 10am PT
vikram: minor gotcha — Vellum returns truncated tokens on last chunk for streaming; we should normalize trailing whitespace and token offsets in eval to avoid false negatives.
morgan: noted. will add a post-processing step to strip/truncate per policy.
sasha: perfect. once we have the first parity report i'll share with the AE and ops. thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
olivia: if legal needs anything from my side ping me.
alex: +1, will prep the cost delta numbers and a suggested canary rollout (10% traffic -> 50% -> cutover).
sasha: ok locking timeline. POC kickoff next Tue. i'll post invites. :rocket:
